entities.summary: Alexandrine Countess von Hutten-Czapska, also known as Aleksandra Joanna Maria Franciszka Fabianna or Aleksandra Adamovna Kolemina-Bacheracht, was a Polish noblewoman, novelist and published fictional works in French under the pseudonym Ary Ecilaw.
